snippet.title: My Desktop Dwarf: Taskbar Forge | Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
You type. He forges. DEMO on Steam now!: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4989440/My_Desktop_Dwarf_Taskbar_Forge/?utm_source=youtube

Meet Brokk, a dwarf blacksmith who works above your taskbar while you type. His wife, Brygida, sells what he makes. Equip and upgrade the forge, discover new patterns, craft new items, and give the workshop a look of its own.

Made by Press Any Key.


#MyDesktopDwarf #IndieGame #DesktopCompanion
